senses.sense_definition: Any of a group of simple proteins that are soluble in water only when salts are present and can be coagulated by heat.

examples.text: The doctor ordered a blood test to measure the level of <w>globulin</w> in the patient's serum.

target_lang_translations.zh: 医生开了一项血液检查，以测量病人血清中<w>球蛋白</w>的水平。

examples.text: Certain types of <w>globulin</w> play a crucial role in the body's immune response to infections.

target_lang_translations.zh: 某些类型的<w>球蛋白</w>在人体对感染的免疫反应中起着至关重要的作用。

target_lang_definitions.zh: 一类简单的蛋白质，仅在有盐存在时溶于水，且能受热凝固。

zh.target_lang_sense_clarification: 生物化学中指代一类不溶于纯水但溶于稀盐溶液的蛋白质。
